title: Marakkar Arabsagar Ka Sher
desc: Kunjali Marakkar IV leads a fearless naval rebellion against European invaders, protecting his homeland through daring maritime warfare and becoming a timeless symbol of courage and resistance.

title: Operation Valentine
desc: This story shows brave Indian Air Force heroes facing tough challenges during a major air attack. They show courage and strength in a fierce battle for India.

title: Savyasachi
desc: Vikram has alien hand syndrome. He falls in love with Chitra, but his life changes when his brother-in-law is killed and his niece is kidnapped. He must save her.

title: Street Dancer 3D
desc: Two rival dance groups from India and Pakistan clash in London. They compete fiercely but find unity through dance, discovering a shared purpose and common ground.

title: Housemates
desc: Newly married Karthik and Anu buy an apartment and begin life there. Strange happenings lead them to fear ghosts, but they soon discover the truth.

title: The Mummy
desc: Adventurer Rick O'Connell and Egyptologist Evelyn, along with a bunch of archaeologists, inadvertently wake up a bedeviled mummy during an archaeological excavation at the ancient city of Hamunaptra.

title: Maari
desc: Maari bullies locals and traps Sridevi in a fake partnership. But she has a plan-love, lies, and revenge collide in this fiery game of wit and deception.

title: Subhedar
desc: Jay Shivaray in Subhedar brings alive the heroic saga of a mighty warrior who sacrifices his life for Swarajya, choosing duty over his son's marriage to raise the victory pylon atop the fort.
